ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Real numbers $x, y, k$ satisfy $\left\{\begin{array}{l}x+y-3 \geq 0, \\ x-y+1 \geq 0, z=x^{2}+y^{2} \text {, if the maximum value of } z \text { is } 13 \text {, then the value of } k \text { is ( ) } \\ x \leq k,\end{array}\right.$
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Regard the system of inequalities as a plane region. From x+y-3≥0, get y≥3-x; from x-y+1≥0, get y≤x+1; then add x≤k. The intersection point of the two lines y=3-x and y=x+1 satisfies 3-x=x+1, solving gives x=1, y=2, so the intersection point is (1,2). To make the region nonempty, the values of x need to satisfy x≥1 and x≤k, therefore k≥1. At this time the vertices of the region are (1,2), (k,3-k), (k,k+1). The objective function z=x^2+y^2 represents the square of the distance from the point to the origin; in this triangular region, for the maximum value it is only necessary to compare the values at the vertices. At the three vertices respectively: z(1,2)=1^2+2^2=5; z(k,3-k)=k^2+(3-k)^2; z(k,k+1)=k^2+(k+1)^2=2k^2+2k+1. For k≥1, the third value is not less than the first two: its difference with the second is (k+1)^2-(3-k)^2=8(k-1)≥0; its difference with the first is 2k^2+2k+1-5=2(k+2)(k-1)≥0. Therefore the maximum value is 2k^2+2k+1. According to the meaning of the problem, the maximum value is 13, so 2k^2+2k+1=13, simplifying gives k^2+k-6=0, that is, (k-2)(k+3)=0, solving gives k=2 or k=-3. Combining with k≥1, obtain k=2.

raw_record.question_text: Real numbers $x, y, k$ satisfy $\left\{\begin{array}{l}x+y-3 \geq 0, \\ x-y+1 \geq 0, z=x^{2}+y^{2} \text {, if the maximum value of } z \text { is } 13 \text {, then the value of } k \text { is ( ) } \\ x \leq k,\end{array}\right.$

method.method_draft: 将不等式组看成平面区域：由 x+y-3≥0 得 y≥3-x，由 x-y+1≥0 得 y≤x+1，再加 x≤k。两条斜直线交于 (1,2)，所以要有非空有界区域需 k≥1，区域顶点为 (1,2)、(k,3-k)、(k,k+1)。目标函数 z=x^2+y^2 表示点到原点距离平方，在这个三角形区域内最大值只需比较顶点处取值：z(1,2)=5，z(k,3-k)=k^2+(3-k)^2，z(k,k+1)=k^2+(k+1)^2。对 k≥1，第三个值最大，因此最大值为 2k^2+2k+1。令 2k^2+2k+1=13，解得 k=2 或 k=-3，结合 k≥1，得 k=2。
